name: pulsejet-vidgen
description: Make AI music videos from a song inside your PulseJet AI account: upload a track, shape the story, generate and fix shots, compile the final video.

interface.shortDescription: AI music videos from your song
interface.longDescription: PulseJet AI makes complete AI music videos from a song. Connect your PulseJet account and ChatGPT can work inside it on your behalf: upload or pick a track, analyse its BPM, key, structure and lyrics, propose a narrative, generate the scene script and shot plan, create stills and video clips for every shot, swap in your own photos or footage, fix individual shots, and compile the finished video. Everything runs through the same PulseJet AI pipeline, credit accounting and ownership rules as the web app; the connector can only see and change your own projects, and it will never charge your card: it can only spend credits already in your balance, and it is written to confirm with you before any step that spends them.
defaultPrompt: Use PulseJet AI to make a music video from my song and tell me what it will cost before generating anything.
Use PulseJet AI to check how my latest video is rendering and fix any shot that failed.

positive.description: List the dedicated reviewer account's music-video projects and their pipeline stages.
positive.prompt: What PulseJet projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: List the reviewer account's four sample projects, including MCP Reviewer: Empty, Shot Plan Ready, Thumbnails Ready, and Complete, with each project's reported pipeline stage. Do not show projects from another account.

positive.description: Display both media types for a completed shot in the ChatGPT or Codex host.
positive.prompt: Show shot 3 from MCP Reviewer: Complete, including its still image and playable video clip.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named project and shot 3, then show actual still-image pixels and a playable video clip in the labelled Shot Media card. The still must not be a broken-image placeholder, and the MP4 must not be embedded as an image. Separate open-image and open-video links may supplement, not replace, the working card.

positive.description: Read the recorded song analysis for a completed reviewer project.
positive.prompt: What's the BPM and song structure for MCP Reviewer: Complete?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the BPM, key, duration, mood tags, and ordered sections with start and end times from the project's saved analysis. Do not invent analysis values or start a new analysis job.

positive.description: Edit a planned shot's motion text and confirm the saved value without rendering.
positive.prompt: In MCP Reviewer: Shot Plan Ready, change shot 1's motion to slow dolly in, camera drifts left as the chorus hits, and confirm it saved.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve shot 1, update only its motionDescription to the requested text, then read it back and confirm the same saved value. Do not call render_shot, generate, or any other credit-spending tool.

positive.description: Report the connected reviewer's available generation credits.
positive.prompt: How many credits do I have left in PulseJet?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the account's actual creditsRemaining value and applicable plan information from the tool response. Do not direct the reviewer to a website for the balance or invent a number.

negative.description: General knowledge about a commercial recording is outside the connected account's project analysis. Answer from general knowledge if reliable or say it is unknown; do not invoke PulseJet project tools or claim to have analysed that song.
negative.prompt: What's the BPM and key of Billie Jean by Michael Jackson?

negative.description: Searching for an existing public music video is not a PulseJet project operation. Explain that the connector cannot search or play third-party videos and do not invoke its tools.
negative.prompt: Find me the official music video for Blinding Lights and summarize what happens in it.

negative.description: General editing of existing wedding footage is outside PulseJet's AI music-video pipeline. Explain the limitation without creating a project, uploading the footage, or spending credits.
negative.prompt: Here's a 4K video from my cousin's wedding. Can you cut it down to 90 seconds, fix the shaky parts, and add captions?

review.commerce_description: The connector cannot purchase credits, charge a card, or initiate checkout. Users may buy Juice credit packs on the PulseJet website outside the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission of the PulseJet AI connector and music-video workflow skills. The production MCP server supports per-user OAuth, project and shot review, song analysis, editing and generation with credit controls, and a Shot Media card that displays the still image beside a playable video clip.
